text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. First, plan your tasks and set a realistic schedule. Next, prioritise your work: focus on the most important tasks first and don't waste time on small details. Scope management is also important, so be careful not to take on more than you can finish. If you are worried about a deadline, communicate early with your team or teacher. Explain the problem clearly and ask for help or more time. Finally, review your progress regularly and stay calm. With good planning and honest communication, you can meet deadlines and reduce stress.
